Edmund climbed back up to his lighthouse, pinned the note beside his logbook, and for the first time in years, felt the vast ocean a little less lonely.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像被按下了静音键。路灯把空荡的街道染成一片昏黄，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，车灯划开薄雾又迅速消失。便利店是唯一还亮着的地方，玻璃窗后值夜班的店员靠着柜台打哈欠。远处传来清洁车低沉的轰鸣，环卫工人推着扫帚，动作缓慢而规律。高楼的轮廓在夜色中模糊成剪影，只有零星几扇窗还透出灯光，像是谁也没睡着。风有点凉，吹过无人的广场，卷起一张被遗忘的传单。这座城市在喧闹之前，难得地呼吸着。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function calls itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\nImagine Russian nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll inside, and you keep going until you reach the tiniest doll that can't open anymore.\nThat smallest doll is called the 'base case', and it's what tells the function to stop instead of going forever."}
